qualifications_or_emphasis: Emphasis of Matter: The Company has incurred recurring operational losses and discontinued its erstwhile manufacturing operations following disposal of major plant, machinery and other fixed assets. Subsequent to reporting date, the Company has initiated business operations in the Agro Commodity sector with effect from April 1, 2026. Disputed statutory demands aggregating to ₹1,091.98 lakhs, including income-tax matters aggregating to ₹939.28 lakhs pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India, treated as contingent liabilities. These events and conditions indicate that a material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: events and conditions that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern over the longer term, subject to possible financial impact of disputed statutory demands and commencement of Agro Commodity business operations subsequent to balance sheet date

outlook.statement: The company will strive to improve its performance in long term prospects based on actual pace of global economy and is hopeful to achieve growth in upcoming years.

The constant efforts of the Company and Research and Developments will lead the Company to the higher level. Despite the difficult external environment, the company will strive to improve its performance in long term prospects based on actual pace of global economy and is hopeful to achieve growth in upcoming years.
commencement of Agro Commodity business operations subsequent to the balance sheet date
The Company has revived its business operations by venturing into Agro Commodity business. It has started its operations in this sector from 1 April 2026.
There are no external borrowings or overdue financial obligations as at balance sheet date, and the Company continues to honour all its statutory and regulatory compliances in a timely manner.
The Company has adequate cash and cash equivalents and low operational overheads, allowing it to sustain basic corporate operations for the foreseeable future.

risks: The Company has adopted and implemented a Risk Management Policy voluntarily which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board may threaten the existence of the Company.
Increasing competition, price volatility, and regulatory changes may pose challenges to the Company.
The Company's assets, including buildings, plant and machinery, vehicles, and stocks, are adequately insured against relevant risks.
